[spoiler=your daily news update!][b][u]Nordiheim News Flash.[/u][/b]

Inn a modern and clean looking news room sits the male reporter known as Jarli, the female reporter is not with him most likely because of the strict rules enforced because of the virus situation.
[i]Welcome to this short, but allways imformative, news flash for your daily and quick update on news in Nordiheim.[/i]
He takes a quick glance on the papers he has on his desk
[i]As many industrial workers have most likely noticed the 'state of emergency' have not had the amount of negative impact on the nations economy as was first feared as work is still plenty, especialy in the military sector, this is belived to be because of the new large trade agreement reached with the British Republic of Bob and the increase of aluminum produced in the Nordland mining and refining sector.[/i]

He moves one of the papers on his desk to the side.
[i]Said Nordlandian sector is now belived to have reached its new full capacity after the opening of the new, and large, aluminium mine earlier this year in its northern part wich oppened many new job possibilities for the local recidents.
This ofcorse have also increased the production numbers in the aerospace industry in a continous effort to update the Nordiheimian airforce to replace the aging KJ-5H Cockatoo with newer and much more capable KJ-6G Kookaburra.[/i]

He turns slightly, leaning a little to his right with his right arm on the desk so that he is resting some of his weight on his elbow, pointing at the picture that comes up on the screen behind him with his left arm, the picture shown is of a somewhat low quality but clearly shows an unkown fighter jet with the Nordiheimian star bellow the cockpit canopy.
[i]Some experts and speculants also belive that the new influx of high quality aluminium that have been aquired the last few years, together with copper from trade have, have invigorated the development of a new fighter jet wich some observers claim to have been seen doing flight tests from the Red Wall mountain military research facility with increased frequency troughout this autumn and winter, tough when questioned the military have not been big on giving any details on this exept saying that they will not discus or talk about military research were anyone can hear it.[/i]

He turns fully towards the camera again.
[i]Tough regardless of them not wanting to talk about it some sources says that its name is Black Swan and we might see it fly the skies of Nordiheim in a more official capacity before the end of the year, hopefully it will have been a good investment of tax payer Gehms ulike the KJ-7 Hawk wich turned into an expensive failure that did not even produce a single usable airplane.[/i]

Moving a few papers to the side he continues.
[i]Another sector that are actualy seing growth is the Ostland and Nordland shipyards and drydocks wich are being upgraded to be able to bether handle larger ships, most likely for both the large cargo ships that have been made as well for the future aircraft carriers that the navy are going to get in the future.
Also on the mater of ships are the new cruiser and two destroyers that are going to arive back to Ostland after their successful sea trials, they are going to join the large transport fleet that are going to transport large amounts of both civilian and military material and food to the Olian islands to both cover their needs aswell as increasing their defences considering the war that is raging in East Shamat and ability to patrol their waters to stop anyone trying to get trough the quarantine[/i]

He now gets a bit more serius leaning slightly forward.
[i]But now for the last part of this news flash that you watchers are the most interested inn.
The many limitations and new rules that was implemented with the State Emergency seems to be working as no cases have been reported any other regions then Ostland and Aboria, tough it should be mentioned that Aboria is the most sparcely populated region of Nordiheim and therefore is easier to stop the spread inn, tough the tottal count of infected have reached over 6000 with the dead numbering 541.[/u]

[i]The national health department have issued several statements aswell, the two most important being that some people groups have been proved to have greater difficulties fighting the virues, among these are the Olians, with the small comunities in western Ostland being hit peticuarly hard, and Aboriginals with little to no Norse genetics, they are not sure yet why this is but the leading theory is that the Norse in their distant past encountered a similar virus and mostly those with immune system traits that helped against such a virus survived and spread these traits.[/i]

Jarli continues while puting a few more papers aside.
[i]The national health department also said that while the various doctors and scientists that are working on identifying and decoding the virus and how to fight and posibly find a cure it is still to soon to say exactly what it is tough they have some ideas based on bether understanding of it, so far it is belived that it might be a dangerously mutated version of the influenza or SARS famely of viruses but that it is also not imposible for it to be related to the Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome, also known as Sin Nombre virus, as it shares some similarities with its symptoms and way of attacking its victims respiratory system.
There is also some potentialy hopefull news starting to appear as some patients in Ostland is showing signs of recovering, it is hoped that it might be possible that these people develop antibodies that can be extracted and replicated to fight the virus.
Another hope is that a new and more harmless version is found that can be used as the bassis of a vaccine.[/i]

He folds his hands together on the desk.
[i]Other than this there is unfortunatly noting more to report as of now, we here at Nordiheim News Channel will ofcorse notify you, our loyal viewers, the moment we know more important information regarding this dastardly Lyondra virus!
This have been Jarli Rudoson with Nordiheim News, thank you for watching.[/i][/spoiler]
